### Quick Picks

- **Baan Thai** – 1110 W. 18th St. (West Loop) – Classic Thai with a dedicated vegetarian menu.
- **Siam Square** – 2001 N. Clark St. (Lincoln Park) – Separate vegetarian menu and vegan-friendly options.
- **Thai Orchid** – 1400 W. 18th St. (West Loop) – Vegetarian Pad Thai, Green Curry, and more.
- **Siam Thai Bistro** – 1200 W. 18th St. (West Loop) – Vegetarian Pad Thai, Green Curry, and customizable dishes.

All of these restaurants are well‑reviewed and offer a range of vegetarian dishes that can be enjoyed without compromising on flavor. Enjoy your meal!
